metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-45.432798, 140.468626) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use OC ESA (OceanColor) chlorophyll-a V6 (300 m, 1-day), dataset id: "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI". - Date ranges: 2019-11-01 → 2020-02-29 (“Nov-2019 to Feb-2020”) vs 2018-11-01 → 2019-02-28 (“the same time the prior year”). 2. Masking: - Native chlorophyll flags (CLDICE and LAND) are already masked in this product; we will only keep pixels flagged as best quality (QA = 0). - The product is log-scaled; convert to linear scale (chl = 10**log_chl) before averaging. 3. Logic: - If either collection is empty (size = 0) → C1. - After masking, compute valid-pixel count; if 0 → C2. - Compute mean surface chlorophyll (mg m-3) for both periods and compare. - A result of None/NaN or impossible value (<0 or >300 mg m-3) → C3. - Otherwise decide A (higher or equal) or B (lower). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & periods pt = ee.Geometry.Point([140.468626, -45.432798]) aoi = pt.buffer(100000) # 100 km p1_start, p1_end = '2019-11-01', '2020-02-29' p0_start, p0_end = '2018-11-01', '2019-02-28' def get_chl_mean(start, end): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(aoi) .select(['chlor_a', 'l2_flags']) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('l2_flags').eq(0))) # best QA .map(lambda img: img.select('chlor_a').multiply(0.001))) # mg m-3 if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 comp = col.mean().multiply(1) # keep scalar cnt = comp.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aoi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a') val = comp.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aoi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a') return val.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo() c0, n0 = get_chl_mean(p0_start, p0_end) c1, n1 = get_chl_mean(p1_start, p1_end) print(f"2018-19 chl: {c0:.3f} mg/m3 Pixels: {n0}") print(f"2019-20 chl: {c1:.3f} mg/m3 Pixels: {n1}") if c0 is None or c1 is None: print("C1") elif n0 == 0 or n1 == 0: print("C2") elif c0 < 0 or c1 < 0 or c0 > 300 or c1 > 300: print("C3") else: if c1 > c0: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & periods
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([140.468626, -45.432798])
aoi = pt.buffer(100000)  # 100 km
p1_start, p1_end = '2019-11-01', '2020-02-29'
p0_start, p0_end = '2018-11-01', '2019-02-28'

def get_chl_mean(start, end):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI')
           .filterDate(start, end)
           .filterBounds(aoi)
           .select(['chlor_a', 'l2_flags'])
           .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('l2_flags').eq(0)))  # best QA
           .map(lambda img: img.select('chlor_a').multiply(0.001)))      # mg m-3
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    comp = col.mean().multiply(1)  # keep scalar
    cnt = comp.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aoi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a')
    val = comp.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aoi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a')
    return val.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo()

c0, n0 = get_chl_mean(p0_start, p0_end)
c1, n1 = get_chl_mean(p1_start, p1_end)

print(f"2018-19 chl: {c0:.3f} mg/m3  Pixels: {n0}")
print(f"2019-20 chl: {c1:.3f} mg/m3  Pixels: {n1}")

if c0 is None or c1 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif n0 == 0 or n1 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif c0 < 0 or c1 < 0 or c0 > 300 or c1 > 300:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    if c1 > c0:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
